object: Inclusive graph-metric radius-two Vietoris--Rips complexes of adjacent-swap permutation graphs
primary_method: Exact F2 column reduction after generating all subsets of maximal cliques of graph squares.
independent_method: Direct Kendall-distance clique enumeration, followed by exact F2 row reduction of third and fourth simplicial boundaries.
general_proof: For six-subsets T,U of [n], deletion pi_T after insertion i_U on H3 is identity when T=U and factors through H3(K_|T∩U|)=0 otherwise. Hence their combined map is a split injection of a direct sum of one H3(K_6) per six-subset.
